paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shabbat 60a according to Dikdukei Soferim, interpreting a teaching before Rav Yosef; the text Hyman uses reads Rav Ada of Naresh.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Shabbat 60a paragraph names Rav Ada of Naresh interpreting before Rav Yosef. Hyman’s distinct Rav Acha bar Shisha form remains his attributed Dikdukei Soferim report, without fresh apparatus collation or an identity merge.
